scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose the root cause of the compiler errors
scenarios.reasoning: The agent performed an efficient and thorough root cause analysis. It correctly identified the primary issue (multi-targeting with .NET Core-only APIs lacking conditional compilation), the cascading error effect, and the separate real bugs. The analysis was well-structured with a clear table and actionable fix suggestions. The approach was methodical — loading the binlog, searching errors, paginating through all 169, examining project files for target frameworks. Minor gaps include not explicitly naming FS0039/FS0001 error codes and not being maximally precise about which TFM each error category belongs to, but the substance of the analysis is correct and insightful.

rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 (.NET Framework 4.7.2) lacks these APIs, hence the FS0039 errors
Recognized FS0072 (type-inference) errors as a cascade downstream of the undefined symbols, not independent bugs
Noted that a small number of net10.0 errors (FS0001 type mismatches) are a separate, real problem
